description: Add promoted links (a page to promote, with an optional headline, image and description) to an Outbrain campaign, up to 50 a call. Outbrain crawls the title and image when they are left out and reviews every link. If the campaign is already ENABLED, enabled links start spending once approved, so that needs confirm:true after the user says yes (or enabled:false per link). Free.
name: add_outbrain_ads_promoted_links
title: Add Outbrain promoted links
